# Test fixtures

**These are SYNTHETIC, deterministic sample data (seed 2026) - NOT real NASA
FIRMS observations.** They are generated by `generate_fixtures.py` for tests
and offline demonstrations only, and are always labeled as sample data
(docs/ARCHITECTURE.md scientific guardrails).

- `sample_aoi/`: clean, gate-passing MODIS/VIIRS active-fire CSVs for a
  Northern-California bounding box (2018-2024) with a deliberately learnable,
  time-varying MODIS->VIIRS calibration relationship so the harmonizer can be
  shown to beat the identity and global-calibration baselines on held-out
  chronological periods.
- `raw_dirty/`: gate-failure fixtures covering every quarantine category
  (out-of-bounds coordinates, negative/missing/non-finite FRP, duplicates,
  invalid timestamps, extreme-FRP review flags, empty files, missing columns).

Regenerate deterministically:

```bash
python tests/fixtures/generate_fixtures.py
```
